Date: 31st October 2026 
 
To, 
BSE Limited  
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
25th Floor, Dalal Street, Fort,  
Mumbai 400001 
 
Scrip Code: 541967 
To, 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, Plot No. C/1, 
G Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex, 
Bandra (East), Mumbai 400051 
 
Trading Symbol: SKYGOLD 
 
Subject: Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call. 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call held today i.e., on 
Saturday, 31st October 2026, on the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial 
Results and Operations of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended  
30th September 2026, is available on the Company’s website at https://skygold.co.in/wp-
content/uploads/2026/10/WhatsApp-Audio-2026-10-31-at-2.32.25-PM.mp3  
 
Further, the transcript of the aforesaid conference call will be intimated to the stock 
exchanges subsequently and published on the Company’s website (www.skygold.co.in).  
 
You are requested to take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
For Sky Gold and Diamonds Limited, 
(Formerly known as Sky Gold Limited) 
 
 
 
 
Mangesh Chauhan 
Managing Director 
DIN: 02138048 
Place: Navi Mumbai 
 
 
Mangesh

Chauhan
